note: Standardized daily close prices acquired from Yahoo Finance. Source-traceable, date and currency semantics explicit. Not repackaged from existing SQLite observations. raw_response_sha256 is the hash of the raw HTTP response body; standardized_content_sha256 is the hash of this saved normalized file. Recorded paths use forward slashes so the manifest resolves on Windows and on Linux, and the files are written with LF line endings so the recorded byte count and SHA-256 are identical on every platform.
